note: Sequoia NF campground at 4,000 ft where a creek meets the North Fork of the Middle Fork Tule River, off Wishon Dr about 12 mi east of Springville; shady and wooded. The Doyle Springs Trail to Mountain Home State Forest starts here. The river runs swift; supplies are in Springville. --Claude
summary: Wishon (Sequoia NF): NOT year-round - 2026 season Apr 10-Nov 21 (FS 2025: May 2-Nov 22), now 'Site Closed'; $36 single / $71 double, $8 extra vehicle; 33 sites, 32 reservable, first-come shoulder in April; max rig 30 ft per rec.gov vs FS '24 feet'; not waterfront kept (river ~20-25 m from sites 20/21/23 but under canopy); website FS link.
flags: SEASON year_round true -> false (04-10 to 11-21): recreation.gov rate seasons run only Apr 10 - Nov 21 2026, and the FS 'Seasons of Use May 2 - Nov 22, 2025' with a 'Site Closed' banner now; the 'year-round' wording on rec.gov and FS ('Open year around') is stale. Status not written as a closure.

FIT CONFLICT: FS 'Some units can accommodate recreational vehicles up to maximum length of 24 feet'; recreation.gov catalog lists 30 ft on 17 sites (Main Loop 11-30 mostly). Wrote rec.gov 30. Either way a 23-ft rig fits.

WATERFRONT not waterfront KEPT (possible creekside): rec.gov 'straddles two forks of the Tule River'; on the topo line the river is ~19-25 m from sites 21 (36.19032,-118.66317), 20 (36.19028,-118.66291) and 23 (36.19031,-118.66340), but every loop is under dense canopy, so no open ground or sightline can be confirmed and there is no per-site map. Worth an AWH look; not upgraded.
SITE COUNT: FS says 31 single + 4 double (35); recreation.gov says 33 (29 + 4) and its catalog has 33. Kept 33.
PHONE keep 661-455-6010 (rec.gov 'facility specific information'); the concession ExplorUS is 559-745-4209 (FS page), and rec.gov's facility phone is 559-539-5230.
Pin 36.19014,-118.66413 is in the Main Loop (site centroid ~36.1898,-118.6643) - fine.
